title: Backstage crew arrival & expense catchall
content:
Purpose: scratchpad for Day 0/Day 1 crew arrival logistics, quick expense capture, and immediate vendor handoffs.

Topline reminders (short):
- Company card only for pre-approved line items: AV, booth shipping, hotel incidentals on check-in. Everyone else pay + submit for reimbursement.
- Scan receipts the minute you have them — use Expensify (tag 'events/aisummit') or the phone pdf scanner. NOTE: pictures > paper copy if you’re in a pinch.
- Per-diem cap: $65/day (breakfast/lunch/dinner combined) unless pre-approved by Priya. Alcohol not reimbursable on meals unless explicitly client-hosted.
- Petty cash float at registration table: $200 (Avery to carry). Reconcile at EOD Day 1.

Arrival / check-in timeline (rough):
- 05:30 — Early crew (Avery, Riley) arrive at loading dock. Confirm booth crate location and unlock code (LogiLock #7982).
- 06:00 — Catering/AV vendor arrival window. Point of contact: Marco (BrightAV) — +1 (415) 555-0189. Confirm mic stands (2x), HDMI splitters (2x), and 1x spare power strip.
- 07:00 — Hotel front-desk check-in for late crew. Confirm receipts itemized (room + tax separate). If they charge incidentals to card, collect invoice.
- 07:30 — Booth build starts. Assign one person to be 'receipt wrangler' (ideally Diego) to capture vendor invoices.

Immediate expense capture template (copy-paste into Expensify or notes):
- DATE | ITEM | AMOUNT | PAID BY (card/cash) | RECEIPT STATUS | TAGS
- 2026-03-14 | BrightAV mic rental (2) | $180.00 | company-card | photo uploaded | events, AV
- 2026-03-14 | Uber (airport -> venue) | $42.30 | personal | receipt attached | travel
- 2026-03-14 | Hotel incidentals (parking) | $28.00 | personal | needs photo | travel, parking

Receipts so far (quick ledger):
- Company card charges pending: BrightAV deposit $400.00 (holds on 2026-03-10). Check card statement after settlement.
- Personal reimbursable totals collected from crew: $342.80 (see below for per-person split).

Per-person quick split (to confirm):
- Riley C: $118.40 (airport UBER + lunch)
- Avery K: $102.20 (hotel incidentals + supplies)
- Diego M: $122.20 (dinner + local transit)

Vendor & local contacts (save to phone):
- BrightAV (on-site AV) — Marco Li, +1 (415) 555-0189, Email: marco@brightav.example
- Crate movers — Union City Logistics, dispatch ext 4, tracking: UC-73492 (ask for 'Redwood - booth #12')
- Last-mile supplies (power strips, velcro, gaffer) — HandySupply SF, 2.4 miles from venue, open 08:00

Shipping/receipts notes: 
- Bill of lading: keep with Diego until crate signed off. If courier leaves 'DELIVERED' without signature, call Logistics within 30 minutes.
- If vendor issues a paper invoice, staple a photo of the invoice and upload to Expensify immediately. Don't rely solely on vendor email unless it includes tax breakdown.

Demo / product ops quick notes (so booth demo billing traces cleanly):
- Use demo API key: events-demo-2026 (do not expose prod keys).
- Token budget for live demos: 50K tokens/day. If we exceed, route guests to pre-recorded clips.
- Local WiFi fallback: tether Riley phone (hotspot name REDWOOD-STAFF). Phone data limit set to 10GB/day, monitor usage.

Expense policy quick hacks (for the crew):
- Meals: itemized receipts required. If no receipt, add 'missing receipt' note + two-line justification and initial from approver.
- Taxis/Ubers: take a screenshot of trip summary + driver tip breakdown.
- Supplies under $25: keep receipt; multiple of these should be submitted as a single expense with line items.

To-do (actionable right now):
- [ ] Avery: pick up petty cash envelope from Finance (location: 3rd floor front desk) — due 2026-03-13 morning.
- [ ] Diego: confirm crate arrival ETA with Union City Logistics by 05:00 on show day. Leave note in JIRA EV-482 comment.
- [ ] Priya: approve overtime headcount for Day 2 (need decision by 2026-03-11).

Quick troubleshooting notes:
- If AV doesn't show up on time: plug demo laptop directly into venue display via HDMI. Bring the small HDMI -> USB-C adapter (Riley's bag).
- If network is flaky: switch demos to local recordings + use QR code to collect emails for follow-up. Keep 'demo-offline' video on USB drive.

End-of-day reconciliation (EOD Day 1):
- Gather all receipts in envelope labeled 'AISummit-EOD1' and hand to Avery.
- Create a single spreadsheet tab named 'EOD1-expense-capture' and paste the quick template rows. Share link to Slack #events for transparency.
- Scan petty cash returns and record remaining float amount. Photograph cash count and upload.

Notes to self (Riley):
- Remember to ask Marco for an itemized invoice (tax line must be present) — needed for GL coding.
- Double-check demo API throttling settings before booth opens (avoid rate-limited 503s).
- Add a reminder to upload receipts before boarding flight home.

Useful links and refs:
- Confluence: AI Infra Summit booth plan (linked above).
- Slack: #events-aiinfra (pin this doc).
- Expense policy: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/FIN/Travel+and+Expense+Policy

Last quick note: this is intentionally messy — copy into Expensify and the shared EOD spreadsheet after the first coffee.
